lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice combining one simple subordinate clause with hobby small talk.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Colleagues chat during a break about hobbies and evening plans.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Talking about interests and giving a small explanation.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik talk about hobbies like music, football, podcasts, or cooking and explain why they enjoy them.

main_focus.name: one-clause hobby explanations
main_focus.description: Use one clear subordinate clause to add a reason or thought about a hobby.
model_examples: Jag spelar gitarr för att det är roligt.
Jag tror att du gillar poddar.
När jag lagar mat, lyssnar jag på musik.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use one subordinate clause in several turns, about 3 examples total.

allowed_supporting_grammar: basic V2 word order in main clauses
basic modal verbs: kan, vill, ska, måste

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use hobby collocations as chunks, not isolated vocabulary drills.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker asks about free time or evening plans.
dialogue_shape.middle: They compare two hobbies and give short reasons using one subordinate clause at a time.
dialogue_shape.ending: They close with a friendly reaction or a plan to talk more later.

target_complexity.repetition: spiral att, för att, and när without stacking them in one sentence

focus: the main hobby or free-time activity discussed
the reason the activity is enjoyable or useful
the final reaction to the hobby idea

sentence_focus: one sentence about a hobby with för att
one sentence with Jag är intresserad av
one sentence with När jag är ledig
one sentence reacting with Det låter roligt
one sentence about evening or free-time plans
